feed.title: Google Cloud: App Engine flexible environment Node.js
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: App Engine flexible environment Node.js

entry.content: To improve security, starting in August 2026, App Engine opts your application into TLS version 1.2 and later. You can opt out until the end of August 2026. Starting in September 2026, App Engine might permanently block insecure traffic with TLS version 1.1 and earlier. For more information, see Secure minimum TLS.
entry.summary: Starting August 2026, App Engine will default to TLS 1.2 and later for enhanced security. You can opt out until the end of August 2026, after which older TLS versions may be blocked. This change aims to protect your applications with more secure communication protocols.
entry.title: Feature: App Engine TLS Update

entry.summary: The Node.js 26 runtime is now available in preview for App Engine flexible environment. This update brings the latest Node.js features and improvements to your applications. You can start using it today to leverage new capabilities.
entry.title: Feature: Node.js 26 runtime now in preview

entry.content: Support for deploying your existing apps in the flexible environment to Cloud Run using the gcloud beta app migrate-to-run command is in Preview. For more information, see Deploy an App Engine app in the flexible environment to Cloud Run.
entry.summary: You can now migrate your existing App Engine flexible environment applications to Cloud Run using the `gcloud beta app migrate-to-run` command. This feature is currently in Preview. Learn more about deploying your App Engine app to Cloud Run.
entry.title: Feature: Migrate App Engine flexible to Cloud Run

entry.summary: The Node.js 24 runtime is now generally available for use.
entry.title: Feature: Node.js 24 Runtime Now Available

entry.content: To increase security, starting in March 2025, support for Transport Layer Security (TLS) version 1.1 and earlier is deprecated. Update your application settings in the App Engine flexible environment to use TLS version 1.2 and later, along with a corresponding secure set of cipher suites (Preview).
entry.summary: TLS 1.1 and earlier support deprecated in March 2025. Update your App Engine settings to use TLS 1.2 or later.
entry.title: Feature: TLS Deprecation Update

entry.content: Support for Node.js 24 runtime is in Preview. Node.js 24 is in the Current release state and enters long-term support (LTS) in October 2025. For more information, see Node.js v24.0.0 (Current) in the Node.js website.
entry.summary: New Node.js runtime now available in preview.
entry.title: Feature: Node.js 24 Runtime
